ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, and without limiting Corio's rights that survive under Section 11.3, Commerce One shall (i) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for a period of up to 6 months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (ii) within 30 days of such expiration or termination, return to Corio all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users in Commerce One's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an exit clause giving us up to 6 months of transition assistance at Commerce One's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiration or termination (not on later request), and certified deletion thereafter. Our playbook requires an orderly wind-down and data return on exit; 90 days of assistance is an acceptable fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 11.4 requiring transition assistance and return of Corio data within 30 days of exit
